business_problem: replace an aging on-premises financial data environment that struggled with new insurance workloads, slower queries, and manual sharing processes.
solution_summary: Landkreditt uses Snowflake on Snowflake to replace an aging on-premises financial data environment that struggled with new insurance workloads, slower queries, and manual sharing processes. Banking and insurance data from across the Landkreditt group are centralized into the DAIRY source-to-insight platform on Snowflake. Snowflake handles ingestion, shared analytics, and cloned development environments more efficiently than the prior on-premises system, especially for insurance risk and premium calculations. Business and technology teams use the unified environment to share up-to-date data, accelerate development, and support regulated financial operations with a single version of truth. Keeping ingestion, storage, transformation, and governed access on one platform reduces copying, simplifies administration, and makes it easier to reuse trusted data for analytics, reporting, and AI.
